name: DCLVBS Connector for OTTO
author: decalvibes

sections.description:
DCLVBS Connector for OTTO connects WooCommerce with OTTO Market.

The plugin provides tools for managing marketplace product data and related OTTO Market workflows directly from WordPress and WooCommerce.

The free version includes core manual marketplace functionality, including:

  • OTTO Market connection and general settings
  • Category mapping
  • Attribute mapping
  • Color mapping
  • Global image mapping
  • Manual single-product export
  • Marketplace visibility preparation and status checks
  • Shipping profile handling
  • Product-level OTTO export settings

The Pro version adds additional functionality, including:

  • Automatic inventory synchronization
  • Automatic price synchronization
  • Automatic product synchronization
  • Automatic order import
  • Automatic receipt import
  • Batch product export
  • Product-specific custom image mappings
  • OTTO order and receipt import tools

An OTTO Market seller account and the required OTTO authorization or API access are needed for live marketplace operations.

External Services

This plugin communicates with external services when their related functionality is used.

OTTO Market API

The plugin communicates with the OTTO Market API to perform marketplace operations.

Depending on the functionality used, data sent to or retrieved from OTTO Market can include product data, categories, attributes, prices, inventory quantities, shipping profiles, marketplace status information, orders, customer and address data contained in marketplace orders, receipts, shipment information, return information, and price-reduction information.

These connections are required to provide the marketplace integration functionality of the plugin.

Service:
https://www.otto.market/

OTTO Market API:
https://api.otto.market/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.otto.market/en/privacy-policy.html

DCLVBS OAuth Bridge

When an administrator starts the OTTO connection using the “Connect with OTTO Market” function, the plugin communicates with the DCLVBS OAuth Bridge hosted by DCLVBS.

The bridge is used to determine the available OTTO connection method, start and monitor an OTTO Service Partner authorization when available, disconnect an existing Service Partner authorization, and provide short-lived OTTO access tokens for active Service Partner connections.

When a connection is started, the connector sends the selected OTTO environment, the WordPress site URL, and a randomly generated connector installation identifier to the DCLVBS OAuth Bridge. The installation identifier is generated once for the WordPress installation and is used together with the site URL to route eligible private pilot connections to the correct installation. If no Service Partner installation is available, the bridge can instead display instructions for creating and using the seller’s own OTTO API credentials.

During an active Service Partner authorization flow, additional technical connection metadata is exchanged as required, including authorization session information, polling information, and connector-side bridge connection credentials.

Marketplace business payloads such as product data, customer data, order data, addresses, receipts, shipments, returns, inventory quantities, prices, and product information are not sent through the DCLVBS OAuth Bridge. Marketplace API requests containing this business data are made directly between the WooCommerce site and the OTTO Market API.

Service:
https://www.dclvbs.com/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.dclvbs.com/datenschutz/

Freemius

This plugin includes the Freemius WordPress SDK.

Freemius is used for functions such as license management, account management, premium-plan handling, and in-dashboard upgrade functionality.

For free users, Freemius can display an opt-in screen for optional sharing of WordPress environment, website, product, and related information. Users can skip this optional data sharing.

Premium license activation, account functions, purchases, and related commercial functionality can communicate with Freemius as required to provide those services.

Service:
https://freemius.com/

Terms of Service:
https://freemius.com/terms/

Privacy Policy:
https://freemius.com/privacy/

Data Practices:
https://freemius.com/privacy/data-practices/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open OTTO Market in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Configure the OTTO Market environment and connection.
  5. Configure the required shipping profile and marketplace mappings.
  6. Review the Dry Run setting before sending marketplace data.
  7. Test the connection before enabling live marketplace workflows.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OTTO Market account?

Yes. Live marketplace functionality requires an OTTO Market seller account and the required authorization or API access.

Does the free version expire?

No. The free version provides the available free functionality without a time-limited trial period.

Does the free version include automatic synchronization?

No. Automatic inventory, price, product, order, and receipt synchronization is available with the Pro version.

The free version provides the core manual marketplace functionality described above.

Is marketplace data sent to Freemius?

The connector does not intentionally send OTTO product, customer, order, address, receipt, shipment, or return payloads to Freemius.

Freemius is used separately for licensing, account, upgrade, purchase, and optional opt-in functionality.

What is the DCLVBS OAuth Bridge used for?

The DCLVBS OAuth Bridge handles the OTTO Service Partner authorization flow and provides short-lived OTTO access tokens to connected installations.

Marketplace business data is exchanged directly with the OTTO Market API rather than being routed through the DCLVBS OAuth Bridge.
